rootCause.policy: The custom demo resolver applied normal application import restrictions to the Metro-generated image module

dependency.moduleInitialization: Allocate a private in-memory array and export registerAsset/getAssetByID
dependency.runtimeBehavior: registerAsset appends supplied local metadata and returns a one-based numeric ID; getAssetByID reads that array

correction.scope: Build-time isolation policy only; no clinical, canonical or demo runtime changes
generatedImportPreconditions: Origin is one of the two exact approved image paths and passes the existing SHA-256 check
Resolved target is the exact audited registry file under the real installed node_modules root
Registry bytes and package metadata match reviewed SHA-256 values
correction.bundleVerification: Exactly one registry source with exact source contents; pinned identity required in embedded and independently validated build evidence
unchanged: Demo signing identity and non-distributable policy

guardrailImpact: Asset identity, authoritative image presentation and security isolation only. No changes to A-J/M-X writer/checkpoint/command semantics. Full runtime/security guardrails still mandatory.
tests: scripts/__tests__/OfflineDemoAssetRegistry-test.ts plus existing audited-bundle, build-policy, imaging-isolation and canonical equivalence suites
limitations: Source/VM tests are not physical image-rendering acceptance. The actual signed APK must independently pass all artifact gates before installation.
